releases.summary: 0.5.80: fix false UPDATE OK on cancel; provide read-only authority-conflict diagnostic ZIP
notes: A declined or empty confirmation is now CANCELLED (exit 5), never UPDATE OK.
The Update BAT explicitly asks confirmation and uses --yes only after consent.
Authority conflicts exit 6 without deleting or overwriting either installation; generate a read-only JSON report.
Tiny Diagnostics_0.5.80 ZIP lets legacy user machines inspect records, both app roots, active Backend and shortcut without installing.
STAGE_RECOVERY reports not-needed as success, not Recovery blocked.
Previously verified Auto Stage safety guards, read-only Golden and rollback remain unchanged.
Actual affected user machine repair remains OPEN until diagnostics and live install are verified; no private LINE/Google secrets shipped.
